projects.title: Brand Size Matcher
projects.tagline: Find your perfect clothing size across 23+ brands
projects.problem: Clothing sizes vary wildly across brands, causing purchase anxiety and high return rates. A Medium in Zara fits completely differently from a Medium in H&M.
projects.solution: Built a free tool that uses IoU-based measurement matching to translate your known size in one brand to the equivalent size across 23 brands, including international and Indian D2C labels.
impact: Covers both international and Indian D2C brands
